status.description: Status is the current status of the IdentityProvider.

IdentityProvider.title: Identity Provider
IdentityProvider.description: IdentityProvider represents an identity provider (IdP) that is used by the Cluster to authenticate and re-authenticate the Users in order for them to obtain and keep a valid Session.

match.description: Match contains a single CEL expression

all.description: All acts as a logical AND operator on its list of CEL expressions

any.description: Any acts as a logical OR operator on its list of CEL expressions

not.description: Not acts as a logical NOT operator of a single CEL expression

none.description: None acts as a logical NOR operator on its list of CEL expressions (i.e. none of the expressions matches)

opa.description: OPA contains an OPA (Open Policy Agent) Rego script

octelium.api.main.core.v1.Condition.title: Condition
octelium.api.main.core.v1.Condition.description: Condition is a policy-as-code expression that is evaluated against the request context. It is used by the Policy rules, the Service dynamic configuration rules, the HTTP Plugins as well as by the IdentityProvider rules.

of.description: Of is the list of the Conditions that must all match

octelium.api.main.core.v1.Condition.All.title: All
octelium.api.main.core.v1.Condition.All.description: All acts as a logical AND operator on its list of Conditions

of.description: Of is the list of the Conditions of which at least one must match

octelium.api.main.core.v1.Condition.Any.title: Any
octelium.api.main.core.v1.Condition.Any.description: Any acts as a logical OR operator on its list of Conditions

of.description: Of is the list of the Conditions of which none must match

octelium.api.main.core.v1.Condition.None.title: None
octelium.api.main.core.v1.Condition.None.description: None acts as a logical NOR operator on its list of Conditions

inline.description: Inline is the OPA Rego script directly provided as a string

octelium.api.main.core.v1.Condition.OPA.title: OPA
octelium.api.main.core.v1.Condition.OPA.description: OPA evaluates the Condition via an Open Policy Agent Rego script

displayName.description: DisplayName is the public IdentityProvider display name that Users see when they try to authenticate

aalRules.description: AALRules is the list of Authenticator assurance level rules

disableEmailAsIdentity.description: DisableEmailAsIdentity disables using the email field in the User spec as an identity to be matched against the information returned by the IdentityProvider during the authentication flow. In other words, if this field is set to true, then you must create an identity for the IdentityProvider with an explicit identifier in the User spec. This field is only meaningful for web-based IdentityProviders only (i.e. the ones with types "github", "oidc" or "saml").

postAuthenticationRules.description: PostAuthenticationRules is the list of the rules that decide whether an otherwise successful authentication via the IdentityProvider is eventually accepted or rejected

github.description: Github sets the Github OAuth2 provider specific options.

oidc.description: OIDC sets the OpenID Connect provider options.

saml.description: SAML sets the SAML 2.0 identity provider options.

oidcIdentityToken.description: OIDCIdentityToken sets the OIDC-based assertion options used for WORKLOAD User authentication

aal.title: AAL
aal.description: AAL is the authenticator assurance level as defined by NIST SP 800-63B

octelium.api.main.core.v1.IdentityProvid.title: AAL Rule
octelium.api.main.core.v1.IdentityProvid.description: AALRule sets the authenticator assurance level (AAL) of the authentication based on the content of the IdentityProvider's assertion. The AAL of the first rule whose Condition matches is the one that is used.

clientID.description: ClientID is the GitHub OAuth2 client ID

clientSecret.description: ClientSecret is the GitHub OAuth2 client secret

octelium.api.main.core.v1.IdentityProvid.title: Github
octelium.api.main.core.v1.IdentityProvid.description: Github sets the GitHub OAuth2 provider specific options

fromSecret.description: FromSecret sets the name of the Secret whose value contains the ClientSecret

octelium.api.main.core.v1.IdentityProvid.title: Client Secret
octelium.api.main.core.v1.IdentityProvid.description: ClientSecret is the GitHub OAuth2 client secret

clientID.description: ClientID is the OIDC OAuth2 client ID

clientSecret.description: ClientSecret is the OIDC OAuth2 client secret

issuerURL.description: IssuerURL is the issuer URL where the OIDC configuration can be obtained automatically by adding this IssuerURL to the path "/.well-known/openid-configuration"

scopes.description: Scopes are the additional scopes to `openid`. The default value is [`profile`, `email`].

identifierClaim.description: IdentifierClaim overrides the default claim (i.e. currently `email`) as the claim whose value is used as the identifier.

checkEmailVerified.description: CheckEmailVerified checks that the `email_verified` claim is set to true.

useUserInfoEndpoint.description: UseUserInfoEndpoint obtains the claims via the UserInfo endpoint.

octelium.api.main.core.v1.IdentityProvid.title: OIDC
octelium.api.main.core.v1.IdentityProvid.description: OIDC sets the OpenID Connect provider specific options

fromSecret.description: FromSecret sets the name of the Secret whose value contains the ClientSecret

octelium.api.main.core.v1.IdentityProvid.title: Client Secret
octelium.api.main.core.v1.IdentityProvid.description: ClientSecret is the OIDC OAuth2 client secret

issuerURL.description: IssuerURL is the issuer URL from which the OIDC configuration, and subsequently the JWKS, is obtained automatically

jwksURL.description: JWKSURL is the URL of the issuer's JSON Web Key Set

jwksContent.description: JWKSContent is the inline content of the issuer's JSON Web Key Set

issuer.description: Issuer is the expected value of the identity token's `iss` claim

audience.description: Audience is the expected value of the identity token's `aud` claim

octelium.api.main.core.v1.IdentityProvid.title: OIDC Identity Token
octelium.api.main.core.v1.IdentityProvid.description: OIDCIdentityToken sets the OIDC-based assertion options used for WORKLOAD User authentication. The WORKLOAD User authenticates via an identity token that is issued by an external OIDC-compliant issuer (e.g. a CI platform or a cloud provider) instead of an interactive login.

effect.title: Effect
effect.description: Effect is the decision of the rule once its Condition matches

octelium.api.main.core.v1.IdentityProvid.title: Post Authentication Rule
octelium.api.main.core.v1.IdentityProvid.description: PostAuthenticationRule decides whether an otherwise successful authentication via the IdentityProvider is eventually accepted or rejected

metadataURL.description: MetadataURL is the SAML 2.0 metadata URL

metadata.description: Metadata is the inline metadata XML content

entityID.description: EntityID is the entity ID. If not set, then the value "https://<CLUSTER_DOMAIN>" is used as the default entity ID.

identifierAttribute.description: IdentifierAttribute is the attribute of the identifier used for authentication. If not set, then the default value "http://schemas.xmlsoap.org/ws/2005/05/identity/claims/emailaddress" is used instead.

forceAuthn.description: ForceAuthn forces re-authentication by the IdP even if the user has a valid SSO session

octelium.api.main.core.v1.IdentityProvid.title: SAML
octelium.api.main.core.v1.IdentityProvid.description: SAML sets the SAML 2.0 identity provider specific options

type.title: Type
type.description: Type is the type of the IdentityProvider

isLocked.description: IsLocked indicates whether the IdentityProvider is locked by the Cluster

octelium.api.main.core.v1.IdentityProvid.title: Status
octelium.api.main.core.v1.IdentityProvid.description: Status is the current status of the IdentityProvider

uid.description: UID is the unique UUID value for the object assigned by the Cluster. Read-only.

name.description: Name is the name of the object. It must be unique within a certain API/Version/Kind tuple.

createdAt.description: CreatedAt is the timestamp of creation of the object. Read-only.

updatedAt.description: UpdatedAt is the timestamp of when the object was last updated. Read-only.

displayName.description: DisplayName is the name that can be shown publicly for the object. Doesn't need to be unique.

description.description: Description is used to describe the object in a short sentence. Maximum characters are 1000.

labels.description: Labels is a map of string keys and values to organize objects.

tags.description: Tags is an optional array of tags that classify the Resource.

annotations.description: Annotations is a map of string keys and values that can be used to store arbitrary metadata about the object.

picURL.description: PicURL is the Picture URL of the resource.

resourceVersion.description: ResourceVersion is a unique ID that represent the current version of the resource object. Used by the Cluster to detect updates.

lastResourceVersion.description: LastResourceVersion is the ResourceVersion of the last update of the Resource.

actorRef.description: ActorRef is the object reference to the Actor resource, typically a Session, who is responsible for the current resource change. If ActorRef is not set, then the current change of the resource was done by the Cluster

actorOperation.description: ActorOperation is the gRPC full method triggered by the actorRef to modify the Resource

isSystem.description: IsSystem means that the resource is created by the Cluster and it cannot be managed by the administrators. Read-only.

specLabels.description: SpecLabels is map used internally by the Cluster for quick searches among lists of objects. Read-only.

isUserHidden.description: IsUserHidden means that the resource object is hidden from ordinary Users and should not be exposed via the User APIs.

isSystemHidden.description: IsSystemHidden means that the resource object is hidden by the Cluster and should not be exposed via the APIs.

systemLabels.description: SystemLabels is a similar map to specLabels. Used only by the Cluster.

octelium.api.main.meta.v1.Metadata.title: Metadata
octelium.api.main.meta.v1.Metadata.description: Metadata is the metadata that is common to every Cluster resource. It carries the resource's identity (i.e. its UID and name), its human-readable information as well as the Cluster-managed bookkeeping of the resource's versioning and provenance.

apiVersion.description: APIVersion is the API version of the reference resource

kind.description: Kind is the resource kind. A kind is unique per an APIVersion.

uid.description: UID is the resource object UID. A UID is unique across the entire Cluster.

name.description: Name is the resource object name. A name is unique per a certain kind.

resourceVersion.description: ResourceVersion is the resourceVersion of the resource.

octelium.api.main.meta.v1.ObjectReferenc.title: Object Reference
octelium.api.main.meta.v1.ObjectReferenc.description: ObjectReference is a reference to another Cluster resource. It identifies the referenced resource by its kind and either its UID or its name.
